'''Crystal''' can refer to the following:

*A [[clear crystal rod]] - a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' stolen by [[Liandrin's group of Black Sisters]].
*The [[Crystal Throne]] - the seat of power in the [[Seanchan]] empire. Believed to be a ''ter'angreal''.
*A [[crystal vial]] - a ''ter'angreal'' recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]].
*A [[red crystal chair]] - a ''ter'angreal'' found in [[Rhuidean]].
